events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer their first Premier League defeat in four months, and only their third of the season, as they lose 3–0 at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. A Premier League thriller at Upton Park sees 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat 브래드퍼드 시티 5–4.
볼턴 원더러스 reach the FA Cup semi-finals with a 1–0 win over 찰턴 애슬레틱 as they hope to challenge for a "Wembley double" of the FA Cup final and Division One play-off final.

질링엄's FA Cup dreams are ended with a 5–0 defeat at 첼시, while a 2–1 defeat at home to 애스턴 빌라 resigns 에버턴 to another season of disappointment in 월터 스미스 's second season as manager. 트랜미어 로버스 are eliminated by 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 after a brave 3–2 defeat.
스탠리 매슈스 , one of the greatest English footballers of all time, dies at the age of 85.
윔블던 become the first team this season to be unbeaten twice in the league by 맨체스터 유나이티드 after holding them to a 2–2 draw at Selhurst Park .

맨체스터 유나이티드 have now extended their Premier League lead to six points as February ends, with 리즈 유나이티드 posing the closest threat, while 아스널 and 리버풀 (along with a resurgent 첼시) pose a more distant threat, and 선덜랜드 are now focused on qualifying for the UEFA Cup rather than challenging for the league title. 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 왓퍼드 continue to prop up the Premier League, with 브래드퍼드 시티 joining them in the drop zone. 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 맨체스터 시티 continue to head the Division One promotion race, with 입스위치 타운, 반즐리, 허더즈필드 타운 and 버밍엄 시티 completing the top six.
